录像下方加一条车辆状态。显示哪几项在「设置 → 系统 → 系统信息」里勾选，默认是转向灯、方向盘、档位、车速、油门刹车、车门、灯光、经纬度等。试验功能
下车后开着哨兵模式时，只有 USB-A 口（哨兵模式存录像的那个）还通电，能接着录。U 盘插在 Type-C 口也可以：下车后它断电，录像会自动改存到 USB-A 口的 U 盘上接着录。
先写入内置存储，分段完成后再转存至 U 盘。U 盘速度不稳时可减少丢帧
超出上限时从最旧的录像删起，删的只有本应用录的文件。留空或填 0 表示不限制：不删任何录像，U 盘写满就停止录制
将环视中的任一路单独放大为悬浮窗。后视一路做左右镜像，与实际后视镜一致
窗口按对角线分成四块，点上、下、左、右那一块就切到前、后、左、右那一路，代替中间的左右划
只在后视与前视之间切换，不经过两侧。按键模式下窗口只分上下两半：上前、下后
校正鱼眼镜头的桶形畸变。仅影响显示，录制的原始画面不变。校正会放大画面中心，清晰度略低于不校正时
角度越大，视野越宽、放大倍数越小（画面更清晰），但边缘拉伸更明显
宽高可分别调至整块屏幕。画面比例保持不变，窗口形状只决定可见范围
窗口移出视野或取景调乱时，用此项恢复默认
三个手势区域、换一路、调取景、贴边隐藏、缩放

For now the button works while this app is in front. To make it work on every screen, the app needs its accessibility service. The head unit has no screen for that, so the app turns it on itself.

Start Shizuku, then tap Grant with Shizuku. Or run this once from a computer:

%1$s

Then reopen this app.
Shortcuts work only while this app is in front.
Accessibility is off, so the key catcher handles other screens. A button pressed within 3 seconds of touching the screen is skipped.

Shizuku is too old. Update it.
Shizuku did not allow this app.

Pair it in the car Bluetooth settings, come back, then press a button

Stream profile set to “%1$s”. Restart the app to apply
Relay write uses internal storage, so it needs developer options
A dashcam writes continuously. Internal flash wears out and usually cannot be replaced.\n\nA USB drive is recommended: it can be replaced, and removed to copy files.

Continuous recording wears out internal flash, which usually cannot be replaced, so recordings go to the USB drive only.\n\nTo choose it anyway, turn on developer options first, under About → Safety notice.
Super mirror on. Middle: swipe up or down to reframe, left or right to change camera. Sides: drag to move

While you signal, a pop-up shows the camera on that side: left signal, left camera. It closes when the signal goes off. The car\'s own views come first: no pop-up in reverse or while the stock 360 or side view is showing. Not shown while the Super mirror is on
Below this speed the car shows its own side view. 0 shows it at any speed
Turn-signal side view on. Signal left or right to see that side
Corrects the fisheye curve before showing it; the three settings below set how wide it looks and where it points. Only changes the pop-up; recordings are not affected
Smaller zooms in. Only applies with Straighten picture on
Positive turns the view towards the rear (the blind spot), negative towards the front. The direction is a guess: if it turns the wrong way, drag the other way
Positive turns the view out towards the road further away, negative down at the car and the ground. The direction is a guess: if it turns the wrong way, drag the other way
Positive turns the picture clockwise to level a tilted horizon. Left and right are separate. If it turns the wrong way, drag the other way
1000 ms = 1 second. 0 closes it as soon as the signal goes off. A stock view still closes it straight away
In D, keeps the side view ready in the background so the picture is there as soon as you signal. The camera stays on while driving, which uses a little more power
Up to half the screen width: the left and right pop-ups meet at the middle
Super mirror framing and position reset
Brightness / noise reduction restored to defaults
Automatic. If a camera shows nothing, assign it here
Camera mapping saved. Restart the app to apply
Back to automatic assignment. Restart the app to apply

Keeps the app alive in the background.\n\nIt does not read or control the screen and collects no data.

行车记录会持续不断地写入数据，而闪存的写入寿命有限；长期如此会消耗车机存储的寿命，且车机存储通常不可更换。

建议插入 U 盘并在设置里选中它。

Experimental, unofficial software with no vehicle safety certification. It does not replace the factory dashcam, reversing camera or blind-spot monitor. Do not use it while driving, and do not rely on its picture to judge the road.
Recordings go to the USB drive only; without a drive, recording does not start. Recordings are not encrypted: anyone with the drive can read them.
The menu is at the top left. Put the action buttons on the driver\'s side in Settings → Interface → Button side. The super mirror is off by default; turn it on in Settings → Super mirror.
If something goes wrong, restart the app. If it continues, export a report from Settings → System → Diagnostics and attach it to an issue.
Open this QR on the phone. Video starts only after someone is watching.

The live surround view is corrected pixel by pixel on the GPU, as straight as in photo playback, instead of in patches. The camera picture goes through the app\'s own GL before it is shown.
